item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
• Each account's weekly usage and reset day now come from Claude Code's own usage report, the one its /usage command shows. About every 15 minutes the app asks for it, once per account, so the numbers and reset days stay current even when that account's Claude window is closed.
  • Each account needs 1 sign-in for this, in a folder only the app uses: in the account's submenu choose Copy sign-in command, run it in Terminal, finish the sign-in in a private browser window as that account, then choose Check now.
  • A row shows only its own account's numbers: if an account's folder is signed in to a different email than the row's, the row shows no reading instead of the other account's.
  • An old reading draws as a solid, slightly faded bar, with its age in grey after the number.

item.title: Version 0.4.5
item.description:
• A reading older than 6 hours now shows its age after the number, such as "22% 18h", instead of a plus, so an old number never looks current. Under a day the age is in hours, then in days, such as "4% 3d".
  • The bar for an old reading stays hollow, and the account's submenu still says when the number was read.
  • The claude-profiles usage command shows the same age.

item.title: Version 0.4.4
item.description:
• The menu now shows only the week: each account's row has the weekly bar, the percent used and the day the week resets. The 5-hour number moved into each account's submenu, and the alert at 90 percent of a 5-hour limit still works.
  • Right after an account's week resets, its bar is empty and reads "new" until the account is used again.
  • A reset counts only when Claude Code reported it in the past week or the account's own readings confirm it. Otherwise the row keeps its last number and shows "?" for the reset day until a reset is confirmed. "Keep usage fresh automatically" gives the app the readings it needs to confirm a reset sooner.
  • After an update, 1 "Updated to 0.4.4" line sits at the top of the menu until you click it, and the "What's New" item under Updates is gone.
  • VoiceOver reads the same 5-hour status as the submenu.

item.title: Version 0.4.3
item.description:
• Each account's row is now 1 weekly bar with a small mark for even pace, the percent used and the day the week resets.
  • The 5-hour column shows only when an account in the menu still has that limit.
  • A reading older than 6 hours shows with a plus, such as "4%+", because the real number is usually higher. A week that has ended shows "?" instead of 0.
  • When a running account stops updating, a "Refresh usage" row appears at the top of the menu. Each account's submenu also has "Claude's usage card..." to open that account's own usage card.
  • New quiet alerts: when a running account stops updating, when an account is on pace to reach its weekly limit early, and at 90 percent of a 5-hour limit.
  • "Keep usage fresh automatically" can refresh an account that stopped updating while your Mac is idle. It is off unless you turn it on.

item.title: Version 0.4.2
item.description:
• Accounts with no 5-hour limit say "No limit" once Claude next reports their usage.
  • If none of your accounts has a 5-hour limit, that column goes away.
  • Verified Ultra accounts no longer have this limit. Other accounts keep theirs.
  • Plan names match Anthropic's new ones: Max 20x is now Ultra and Max 5x is now Max.

item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description:
• When Claude stops updating usage, the menu now says so and how to resume it.
  • Uses less memory while reading usage on Macs with a lot of Claude Code history.
  • Doctor shows the same weekly reset time as the menu.

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
• Claude Profiles is now SupaConductor. The menu bar shows SC.
  • Usage readings show their age: after 30 minutes the bar fades and says when it was read, after 6 hours it turns hollow.
  • Weekly reset times appear only when Claude Code reported them or your history confirms them, so they no longer show the wrong day.

item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description: • Click a profile's name to focus it or launch it, no submenu needed

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
• Shows when each account's weekly limit resets, taken from Claude Code's own limit notice
  • A narrower, calmer menu: just your accounts and their 5-hour and weekly bars
  • The reset time on hover no longer covers the account's submenu
